newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens easier after Dow's reversal.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens easier after Dow's reversal.

text.p: The FTSE 100 opened weaker on Monday, easing from the record levels set on Friday, after the Dow's early rally faltered, dealers said.
At 0844 GMT, the leading FTSE 100 stocks index was 15.5 points lower at 4,260.3.
The Dow, up 43 points when London closed, ended 10.77 points lower at 6,813.09, though most broader indices held on to gains.

"I think it will be a fairly quiet morning," said one dealer. "Friday's (U.S.) figures showed there's still growth, but that inflation isn't a problem. I think the market will sort of drift until this afternoon's (U.S.) NAPM."
